messages:
maria (Support): multiple customers reporting blank charts in Console. Getting 500s from analytics-api for chart queries since ~07:42 UTC.

sam (oncall): can you paste a failing request id + tenant and any network tab screenshot?

maria (Support): tenant=org_8243, req=req_20260305_9ab3. Network: GET /v1/analytics/series?range=1h -> 500 and spinner never resolves.

maria (Support): repro steps: 1) Login as org_8243 2) Console -> Usage -> Token usage tile 3) Chart attempts load, stays spinning, console shows 500 Internal Server Error

maria (Support): curl we ran: \n```\ncurl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/analytics/series?org=org_8243&start=2026-03-05T07:30:00Z&end=2026-03-05T08:30:00Z&resolution=1m" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \\n  -H "X-Request-Id: req_20260305_9ab3"\n````

maria (Support): response: \n```\nHTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error\n{\n  "error": "internal_server_error",\n  "message": "panic: runtime error: invalid memory address",\n  "trace_id": "trace-7f3b"\n}\n```\n
analytics-bot: alert: High 500 rate on analytics-api (service=analytics-query). 75 errors/min since 07:40 UTC. https://monitoring.redwood.ai/alerts/AN-482

li (eng-ml): Im taking a look. Initial guess: aggregation planner hits a nil when grouping by high-cardinality labels. Any example payloads?

sam (oncall): @li attached the exact payload in the PD ticket. Also saw latency spikes right before these 500s  could be memory pressure then panic.

maria (Support): additional proxied log from api-proxy:\n```\n2026-03-05T07:41:22Z api-proxy ERROR request=req_20260305_9ab3 upstream=analytics-api status=500 msg="panic: nil pointer deref"\n```\n
jordan (Support Lead): escalating to eng-analytics + eng-runtime. Creating SUP-2026-324. @maria please DM affected customers so we can notify. We'll offer workaround.

sam (oncall): temporary mitigation: switch the dashboard to daily aggregation or remove extra group-bys to avoid that aggregation path. Rolling back the recent parsing change might also stop the panics.

li (eng-ml): I reproduced locally by synthesizing empty label arrays + grouping on client_version+route. Fix: add nil-guards in aggregation planner and add unit tests. Opening hotfix branch.

sam (oncall): ETA?

li (eng-ml): PR in ~30m, canary in staging ~1h. Will update.

maria (Support): impacted orgs: org_8243, org_9130, org_4455, org_9982, org_1102. DMing their contacts now.

analytics-bot: incident SUP-2026-324 created; severity=high; playbook=analytics-500s. https://confluence.redwood.ai/playbooks/analytics-500s

jordan (Support Lead): sending proactive updates to customers. Ping here when canary/rollout complete. :pray:

li (eng-ml): PR: github.com/redwood/analytics/commit/3f9e1ab - add guard + test. Will watch perf.

sam (oncall): enabling canary and will watch error rate. Adding temporary alert suppression to reduce noise after patch.

li (eng-ml): canary passed in staging. Pushing prod-canary now.

analytics-bot: deployment event: service=analytics-api version=3f9e1ab deployed to prod-canary by li at 2026-03-05T09:16:00Z

sam (oncall): prod-canary looks stable for 20m; error rate fell to ~2/min. Starting full rollout.

maria (Support): updating customers: graphs should recover within 10 minutes, apologies for interruption.

jordan (Support Lead): closing the escalation once customers confirm. great work team :tada:
